summary: Builds new line strips from points or existing line strips. It can split lines by a LineBreak attribute, a LineStripIndex attribute, distance thresholds, every N points, input line breaks, or simple point order.

key_params.name: connecmode
key_params.note: Use no connectivity, one line strip from point order, or input line strips

key_params.name: linebreakname
key_params.note: Attribute name used to trigger line breaks

key_params.name: linestripindexname
key_params.note: Attribute name used to assign points to line strips

key_params.name: useinputlinebreaks
key_params.note: Respect line breaks already present on input line strips

key_params.name: everyn
key_params.note: Enable line breaks every N points

key_params.name: n
key_params.note: Point interval for Every N Points

key_params.name: bydistancethreshold
key_params.note: Split when point-to-point distance exceeds a threshold

key_params.name: distancethreshold
key_params.note: Distance threshold for splitting line strips

key_params.name: distancethresholdattr
key_params.note: Per-point or per-edge attribute that supplies distance thresholds

key_params.name: outputlinebreakattr
key_params.note: Output a line-break attribute describing the generated splits

key_params.name: outputlines
key_params.note: Create output line geometry after computing break data

key_params.name: linetype
key_params.note: Output line strips or separate line primitives

key_params.name: cpureadback
key_params.note: Enable CPU readback for diagnostics or downstream CPU consumers

key_concepts: Connection Mode selects whether loose points, one point-order strip, or existing input line strips provide the starting topology.
Break rules can come from LineBreak attributes, LineStripIndex attributes, input break data, every-N cadence, or distance thresholds.
Output options separate computing break metadata from emitting line geometry, and can choose line strips or independent line primitives.
common_gotchas: LineBreak uses 1 to start a new line and 0 to continue; inverted logic creates fragmented output.
Use LineStripIndex from Line Metrics when preserving existing strip identity matters.
Distance splitting is sensitive to scale, so normalize or limit P before using threshold-based breaks.
